newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer says CFO Miettinen to resign April 1.
newsitem.headline: Amer says CFO Miettinen to resign April 1.

text.p: Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Tuesday Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Kari Miettinen was resigning "at his own request" as of April 1, 1997.
"Miettinen will continue in his current job until the end of March when he will leave the Group," Amer said in the statement, but it did not say who would replace him.
Both Miettinen and Amer CEO Roger Talermo said the resignation was for personal reasons.
"I have a few candidates to choose from. I think that during the month of January we can announce a successor," Talermo said by telephone.
